summary: Bottom of the bend, bush opposite; houses 15 to 20 m up the bank.
reasons: Bush and park opposite the kerb
Homes about 15 to 20 m, set back

drivers.seclusion: Bush and parkland on the south side; nearest dwelling 10 m at 13 m, others further along the same side.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road with room beside the lane; cars park nearby on the bends.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential road, light traffic; a school and court lie further north.
drivers.convention: A few residents' cars park around the bends, so a van will not be unusual.

flags: Steep: about 6% at best section, up to 16.6% elsewhere
sun_shade: Open to the north and midday; trees shade the south side and the corner.
cannot_judge: Exact home distances from the straight section

best_section.where: Straight bottom of Dennis Street, below the green-roofed shed
